hook: Since 2011, 245 people have died in quad bike accidents across Australia.

sections.voiceover: Since 2011, 245 people have died in quad bike accidents across Australia.
On November 17, 2026, work health and safety ministers agreed to progress new regulatory reforms. Between 2021 and 2025, 73 people died in incidents. How many lives were lost this year?
As of November 5, 2026, there have been 17 recorded quad bike fatalities.
Ministers are implementing these reforms to address the 73 deaths recorded between 2021 and 2025. Safe Work Australia reports 43 of those 245 total victims were aged 19 or under.
Australia records 17 quad bike deaths as of November 2026.
